newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seita continues fall on Liggett deal.
newsitem.headline: Seita continues fall on Liggett deal.

text.p: Shares in French tobacco company Seita remained under pressure on Monday, suffering from last week's admission of liabilities by U.S. Liggett Group on health hazards of smoking.
"There is nothing new on Seita as far as I know," said a senior equity saleswoman, who added the Liggett deal was the main factor for depressing the stock price.
Seita was down 2.08 percent at 202.5 francs, on turnover of 25,758 shares at 1045 GMT. The market was up 0.32 percent.
Liggett agreed with 22 U.S. states to pay $25 million, a quarter of future profits, and to hand over sensitive industry papers to the authorities.
